introHtml: Cotton poly fabric blends combine the softness of cotton with the durability of polyester, making them ideal for medical healthcare items that need to withstand frequent washing and wear. Whether you are outfitting a hospital with branded scrub caps or distributing comfort kits with cotton poly eye masks and pillowcases, this material offers breathability and long-lasting color retention for your logo. Choose cotton poly for a professional, comfortable look that holds up in demanding healthcare environments.
